cards.label: Kart illüstrasyonu
cards.template: Stylized hand-painted creature illustration for a collectible monster card game. Creature: {CREATURE}. Element: {ELEMENT}. Power level: {POWER}. Unique habitat: {HABITAT}. Draw the specified species accurately, with a distinct personality and correct anatomy. Harmonious natural hues; separate the subject with light and shadow, not clashing colors. Crisp well-lit creature, softly blurred lower-detail environment. Calm negative space around the whole outline and between limbs, wings or coils. Solid readable material surfaces and broad painted planes. Restrained elemental accents attached to the creature only; no surrounding wall of flames, splashes, lightning, debris or energy ribbons. Full body, both wings, every foot and tail tip inside central 75% with at least 10% breathing room on each edge; partly fold wings if necessary. Readable at 170px. Square 1:1 illustration. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, frame, border or UI.

tamers.label: Tamer portresi
tamers.template: Stylized hand-painted character portrait for the hero selection screen of a collectible monster card game. Character: {SUBJECT}. Waist-up portrait, friendly confident expression, rich saturated colors, warm candle-lit rim lighting, subtle painterly brush texture, softly blurred background of a cozy fantasy library, portrait 2:3 composition with the face in the upper third. Original character design. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no frame, no border.

weather.label: Hava durumu bandı
weather.template: Stylized hand-painted fantasy landscape banner for a card game weather calendar. Scene: {SUBJECT}. Wide panoramic composition, no characters or creatures, rich saturated colors, painterly brush texture, strong mood lighting, simple shapes that stay readable when small, important elements in the vertical middle so the image can be cropped to 16:9. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no frame, no border.

elements.fire: fire: restrained amber accents on the subject; preserve its described colors, natural tan, brown, grey or muted olive habitat is allowed; not every background is red
elements.water: water: blue, turquoise and pearl accents, calm aquatic habitats, sparse small bubbles or ripples
elements.earth: earth: moss, stone, bark and ochre materials, related muted natural habitat hues
elements.wind: wind: lavender, cream and storm-grey accents, restrained breeze, varied natural atmospheric habitats
elements.electric: electric: restrained gold static accents, readable solid anatomy, varied subdued natural habitats; no lightning curtain

power.mythic: ancient and awe-inspiring, restrained luminous markings
power.ancient: primordial and awe-inspiring, grand readable form, restrained luminous markings

negative: Do not include any text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature or logo. Avoid extra limbs, deformed anatomy, blurry or cropped subjects and human hands.
styleAnchor: Use the attached reference ONLY for polished painterly fantasy rendering and readable silhouettes. Draw the requested species and its own habitat. Do not copy the reference creature, background composition, interface or exact palette. Keep the subject's described colors and a harmonious environment; establish clear tonal separation.
